camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeAssetList --region cn-hangzhou --Status open --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --OutStatistic true --PageSize 10 --MemberUid 2580394279020000 --IpVersion 4 --Lang zh --ResourceType EIP --SearchItem '192.0.XX.XX' --SgStatus pass --Type eip --CurrentPage 1 --NewResourceTag discovered_in_1_hour --UserType buy --SensitiveStatus open
description_en: Queries information about assets protected by Cloud Firewall
description_zh: 查询云防火墙防护的资产的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-asset-list --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --region-no cn-hangzhou --status open --search-item 192.0.XX.XX --type eip --resource-type EIP --sg-status pass --ip-version 4 --member-uid 2580394279020000 --user-type buy --new-resource-tag discovered_in_1_hour --out-statistic true --sensitive-status open --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAssetList

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paginated query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of Cloud Firewall-protected assets to display on each page in a paginated query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含云防火墙防护资产的数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Cloud Firewall.

For more information about regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙所在的地域ID。

关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en:
The Cloud Firewall status. Valid values:

open: Protected.
opening: Protection enabling.
closed: Not protected.
closing: Protection disabling.

If this parameter is not set, all firewall statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙状态。取值：

open：保护中。
opening：保护开启中。
closed：保护未开启。
closing：保护关闭中。

不设置该参数表示查询所有防火墙状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The IP address or instance ID of the asset
parameters.name: search_item

parameters.help_en:
The asset type. Valid values:

BastionHostEgressIP: Bastion host egress IP.
BastionHostIngressIP: Bastion host ingress IP.
EcsEIP: ECS EIP.
EcsPublicIP: ECS public IP.
EIP: Elastic IP address.
EniEIP: Elastic network interface EIP.
NatEIP: NAT EIP.
SlbEIP: SLB EIP (CLB EIP).
SlbPublicIP: SLB public IP (CLB public IP).
NatPublicIP: NAT public IP.
HAVIP: High-availability virtual IP.
NlbEIP: NLB EIP.
ApiGatewayEIP: API Gateway public IP.
AlbEIP: ALB EIP.
AiGatewayEIP: AI Gateway public IP.
GaEIP: GA EIP.
SwasEIP: Simple Application Server public IP.
EcdEIP: Elastic Desktop Service public IP.
BastionHostIP: Bastion host IP
parameters.help_zh:
资产类型。取值：

BastionHostEgressIP：堡垒机出口IP。
BastionHostIngressIP：堡垒机入口IP。
EcsEIP：ECS EIP。
EcsPublicIP：ECS公网IP。
EIP：弹性公网IP。
EniEIP：弹性网卡EIP。
NatEIP：NAT EIP。
SlbEIP：SLB EIP(CLB EIP)。
SlbPublicIP：SLB 公网IP(CLB 公网IP)。
NatPublicIP：NAT公网IP。
HAVIP：高可用虚拟IP。
NlbEIP：NLB EIP。
ApiGatewayEIP：API网关公网IP。
AlbEIP：ALB EIP。
AiGatewayEIP：AI网关公网IP。
GaEIP：GA EIP。
SwasEIP：轻量应用服务器公网IP。
EcdEIP：无影公网IP。
BastionHostIP：堡垒机IP
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The security group policy status. Valid values:

pass: Delivered.
block: Not delivered.
unsupport: Not supported.
If this parameter is not set, all security group policy statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
安全组策略状态。取值：

pass：已下发。
block：未下发。
unsupport：不支持。
不设置该参数表示查询所有安全组策略状态
parameters.name: sg_status

parameters.help_en:
The IP version of the assets protected by Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

4 (default): IPv4.
6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙防护的资产的IP版本。取值：

4（默认）：IPv4。
6：IPv6
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Cloud Firewall member account
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
The user type. Valid values:

buy (default): Paid user.
free: Free user
parameters.help_zh:
用户类型。取值：

buy（默认）：付费用户。
free：免费用户
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The time when the asset was discovered. Valid values:
discovered in 1 hour: The asset was discovered within 1 hour.
discovered in 1 day: The asset was discovered within 1 day.
discovered in 7 days: The asset was discovered within 7 days
parameters.help_zh:
资产发现的时间。取值：
discovered in 1 hour：资产是1小时内新增的。
discovered in 1 day：资产是1天内新增的。
discovered in 7 days：资产是7天内新增的
parameters.name: new_resource_tag

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query outbound traffic information
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询外联流量信息
parameters.name: out_statistic

parameters.help_en: The status of data leakage detection
parameters.help_zh: 数据泄漏检测开启状态
parameters.name: sensitive_status
